WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE CAST(o.date_order_placed AS CHAR) >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25'
    AND CAST(o.date_order_placed AS CHAR) <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44'
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_order_count
  FROM order_counts
)
SELECT 
  oc.gender,
  oc.order_count,
  oc.order_count - ac.avg_order_count as above_average
FROM order_counts oc
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
WHERE oc.order_count > ac.avg_order_count
ORDER BY oc.gender;
